name: Turn-Based Door
description: Doors toggle open ↔ closed on every box pick. The maze becomes a timing puzzle.
howToPlay: A 3-wide door at row 2 controls access to the top row. Every box you pick flips all active doors. Pick the purples (always reachable) to advance the door's rhythm; pick a top-row box when the door is open. Soft-lock warning: time your picks carefully — there are exactly enough purples for one full clear.
author: Claude

showcaseLevel.name: Door Rhythm
showcaseLevel.desc: Time the door — purples flip it, colored boxes need it open.
